AI disclaimer: Created with the help of Deepseek V4 Pro.

## Purpose
CudaCommunicator inherits all_gather() from DeviceCommunicatorBase, which calls dist.all_gather_into_tensor() which is a raw PyTorch ProcessGroupNCCL operation. ProcessGroupNCCL has a watchdog thread that periodically calls isCompleted() → hipEventQuery() on events recorded in the CUDA graph capturing stream. HIP does not permit querying events in a capturing stream, causing hipErrorCapturedEvent and a crash across all ranks.

CudaCommunicator already uses pynccl_comm (which wraps NCCL directly without the ProcessGroup watchdog) for reduce_scatter, broadcast, send/recv, and all_gatherv. Only all_gather was missing the override.

The crash is triggered by tensor_model_parallel_all_gather() calls in /vllm/lora/layers/column_parallel_linear.py:64 inside LoRA column-parallel linear layers.

The fix is to call ncclAllGather() directly with pynccl_comm.all_gather instead of using dist.all_gather_into_tensor which wraps it in pytorch event management.

## Test Plan
```
vllm serve /home/arli/models/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-GPTQModel-Int8 \
--port 8000 \
--scheduling-policy priority \
--max-num-seqs 16 \
-tp 8 \
--attention-backend TRITON_ATTN \
--dtype float16 \
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --max-model-len 32768 \
--max-num-batched-tokens 1024 \
--served-model-name Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
--enable-lora --max-lora-rank 64 --max-loras 1 --max-cpu-loras 1 --lora-modules \
test-lora=/home/arli/loras-70b/Llama-3.3-70B-ArliAI-RPMax-v3-LoRA \
```
Crash can be reproduced with any other model as long as lora modules are enabled.

## Test Result
Before fix:
```
Capturing CUDA graphs (mixed prefill-decode, PIECEWISE):   0%|
[rank6]: hipErrorCapturedEvent
...all ranks crash with ProcessGroupNCCL watchdog exception...
RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed
```

After fix:
```
prefill-decode, PIECEWISE): 100%|
```

Fixes issue https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/41622

Tested on 8× Radeon Pro W6800 with Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-GPTQModel-Int8, TP=8, LoRA enabled. Before the fix: crash during CUDA graph capture. After the fix: CUDA graph capture completes successfully, server starts, and LoRA inference works correctly.

No observable performance regression. Both paths call ncclAllGather.

---

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces an all_gather implementation for CudaCommunicator that leverages pynccl_comm to prevent potential watchdog crashes during CUDA graph capture on ROCm. The review feedback correctly identifies that the NCCL-based all_gather requires the input tensor to be contiguous to avoid incorrect data gathering, and provides a specific code suggestion to address this.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The `pynccl_comm.all_gather` method (and the underlying NCCL call) operates on raw memory pointers and expects the input tensor to be contiguous. If `input_` is a non-contiguous view (e.g., a result of a transpose or a slice), this will lead to incorrect data being gathered because NCCL will read `numel()` elements linearly from the data pointer. You should ensure the input tensor is contiguous before passing it to the communicator.

```suggestion
            pynccl_comm.all_gather(output_tensor, input_.contiguous())
```

@@ -343,6 +343,35 @@ def destroy(self):
             self.all2all_manager.destroy()
             self.all2all_manager = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
 
+    def all_gather(self, input_: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
+        world_size = self.world_size
+        # Bypass the function if we are using only 1 GPU.
+        if world_size == 1:
+            return input_
+        if dim < 0:
+            dim += input_.dim()
+        input_size = input_.size()
+        # Use PyNCCL's all_gather to avoid ProcessGroupNCCL watchdog
+        # thread crashes (hipErrorCapturedEvent) during CUDA graph capture
+        # on ROCm.
+        pynccl_comm = self.pynccl_comm
+        if pynccl_comm is not None and not pynccl_comm.disabled:
+            input_ = input_.contiguous()
+            output_size = (input_size[0] * world_size,) + input_size[1:]
+            output_tensor = torch.empty(
+                output_size, dtype=input_.dtype, device=input_.device
+            )
+            pynccl_comm.all_gather(output_tensor, input_)
+            output_tensor = output_tensor.reshape((world_size,) + input_size)
+            output_tensor = output_tensor.movedim(0, dim)
+            output_tensor = output_tensor.reshape(
+                input_size[:dim]
+                + (world_size * input_size[dim],)
+                + input_size[dim + 1 :]
+            )
+            return output_tensor
+        return super().all_gather(input_, dim)
